summary: Kerb on a junction approach with painted chevrons and no parked cars.
reasons: Painted chevron island beside the kerb
No parked cars; through road at junction

drivers.seclusion: Creek park and trees behind the kerb, but homes 19-24 m opposite and the spot is in view of the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: The kerb runs along the approach to a junction with a chevron island and tight lanes; no room to pull fully out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy junction of Indooroopilly Road with turning traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; no signs.

flags: Low-lying: 3.5-3.9 m elevation, Toowong Creek 10 m away
Homes 19-24 m away across the road
sun_shade: Trees shade the kerb from the north and east; open to afternoon sun from the west.
